description:
Subscribe to a claim denial event for a given scan_id. Blocks up to `timeout_seconds`. Returns {status: 'denied', ...} as soon as the payer marks the claim denied in claim_status_history, or {status: 'timeout'} if no denial observed within the window.

WHEN TO USE: Caller wants to stream denial events for a set of claims.

WHEN NOT: One-shot queries.
name: watch_claim_denial
